scope: Only the eventual experiment process own /proc/self/task subtree: WRITE_FILE and TRUNCATE for temporary per-thread kernel metadata. No file creation, removal or rename rights in /proc.
preserved_controls: Persistent writes remain under the one owned experiment root. Other process task trees receive no write permission. Existing NVIDIA character-device I/O and /dev/null are unchanged. No system security setting, shared library, dependency or model change.
reason: Actual CUDA driver cuInit failed with error304 and a traced EACCES opening its own thread comm with O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC.
enforcement: Install process-specific Landlock rule in each worker before exec; never grant all /proc or inherit a parent PID exception as if it covered a child.
